Message.Name: Symbol Status
Message.Description: Symbol Status messages contain information regarding equity, debenture, or trading Instruments for the current trading day for the Alpha market. One message is disseminated for each valid symbol at the beginning of each trading day.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: A unique alphanumeric identifier for a security

Field.Name: Stock Group
Field.Description: An identifier of the stock group

Field.Name: Listing Market
Field.Description: The market on which a security is listed.

Field.Name: Product Type
Field.Description: The product type for a symbol

Field.Name: CUSIP
Field.Description: Clearing and settlement registration number

Field.Name: Board Lot
Field.Description: Contains the board lot size

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: The currency associated with a reported price

Field.Name: Face Value
Field.Description: The face value of a debenture

Field.Name: Last Sale
Field.Description: Last sale price of a stock

Field.Name: MinPOQty
Field.Description: The minimum volume required for Post Only orders.

Field.Name: Stock State
Field.Description: The state of the stock

Field.Name: Test Symbol
Field.Description: Indicates the symbol is a test symbol

Message.Name: Trade
Message.Description: A Trade message is generated each time a trade occurs.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: A unique alphanumeric identifier for a security

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The price in a valid currency

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The quantity of shares for an order or trade

Field.Name: Buy Broker Number
Field.Description: An Exchange-assigned public number uniquely identifying a Partici-pating Organization associated with a buy order

Field.Name: Sell Broker Number
Field.Description: An Exchange-assigned number uniquely identifying a Participating Organization associated with a sell order

Field.Name: Bypass
Field.Description: An indicator for bypass crosses, which can be printed outside of the Protected NBBO and are not subject to cross interference.

Field.Name: Trade Time Stamp
Field.Description: The time at which the trade occurred, manually set when a trade is added

Field.Name: Settlement Terms
Field.Description: Settlement terms associated with the order

Field.Name: Cross Type
Field.Description: Type of crosses originating from a Participating Organization between managed accounts that have the same manager

Field.Name: Last Sale
Field.Description: Last sale price of a stock

Field.Name: Opening Trade
Field.Description: Indicates whether the trade occurred at the opening or was the first board lot trade of the day.

Field.Name: IsDark
Field.Description: Indicates at least one side of the trade is dark. Always set to “N”.

Field.Name: Trade Number
Field.Description: A unique identifier per stock assigned to each trade

Message.Name: Trade Cancelled
Message.Description: A Trade Cancelled message is generated each time a trade is cancelled.

Message.Name: Stock Status
Message.Description: A Stock Status message is disseminated in response to a change in stock status from the Trading Engine. It contains information regarding the current state of the stock.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: A unique alphanumeric identifier for a security

Field.Name: Comment
Field.Description: A text field corresponding to a reason code entered when a stock is halted; or, the initiator of a delayed opening on a stock, or when there is a change to the Oddlot trader on a stock.

Field.Name: Stock State
Field.Description: The state of the stock

Field.Name: Trading System Time Stamp
Field.Description: The time at which the event being reported occurred in the Trading Engine

Field.Name: Resume Trade Time
Field.Description: The time at which a halted stock will resume trading
